The contractor will establish and operate this pool, ensuring the timely identification, mobilisation and quality assurance of experts assigned to specific requests from GIZ, covering regional cooperation on trade, investment and employment; digital and telecommunications regulation; digital skills; and cybersecurity. The contractor shall establish and operate a STEP capable of rapidly assessing and responding to technical support requests from GIZ; identifying, mobilising and managing qualified short-term experts; delivering high-quality, results-oriented technical assistance, analytical work and capacity development; and ensuring quality assurance, knowledge management and reporting in accordance with GIZ standards. Work is organised into four interrelated Work Packages: Work Package 1 - Regional cooperation on Trade, Investment and Employment: technical expertise on regional economic integration, employment and private sector development, including trade facilitation, investment climate reforms, competition policy, sustainable value chains, SME competitiveness, employment promotion, and Union for the Mediterranean processes and initiatives. The contractor is responsible for the selection, preparation and steering of all experts, and for proposing at least two suitable candidates per assignment request within three working days. Weiterhin beinhaltet die Maßnahme die Überwachung der Erneuerung der Weichen W10 und W54, die Erneuerung von Gleis 50, die Errichtung neuer Betriebsgebäude und Schalthäuser sowie die Anbindung und Anpassung bestehender Stellwerks- und Betriebsführungssysteme. Die Umsetzung erfolgt unter laufendem Eisenbahnbetrieb in mehreren Bauphasen mit mehreren Inbetriebnahme- und Softwarewechselzuständen auf den Strecken 6153, 6345 und 6206 und im Bf. Guben. Darunter zählen Grundleistungen (Anlage 01.01), Eisenbahnbetriebliche Leistungen ( Anlage 01.02), Bauaufsichtliche Leistungen (Anlage 01.03), Abfallmanagement (Anlage 01.07) und Umweltfachliche BÜW (Anlage 01.11).
